full_judgment:
2. It appears that the petitioner filed a suit being the Title Suit No. 814 of 2008, in the Court of Senior Assistant Judge, Sadar, Comilla, praying for a decree for declaration that the proceedings of Small Causes Court Case No.3 of 2004 and the S.C.C. Execution Case No. 1 of 2007, are illegal and not binding upon the plaintiff, contending inter-alia that he purchased the property from the defendant No. 1. But the learned Assistant Judge, on hearing the maintainability of the suit, found that the defendant No. 1 was a tenant under Amena Begum and others and was the defendant in S.C.C. Suit No. 3 of 2004 filed by them. The said S.C.C. suit was decreed which was upheld upto the Appellate Division. On these findings, the said suit was dismissed as not maintainable. 

 4. Thereafter, the plaintiff-petitioner obtained a Rule in Civil Revision No. 2209 of 2009. Subsequently, on his prayer, the High Court Division, by its Order dated 26.07.2009 stayed the further proceedings of the S.C.C. Execution Case No. 1 of 2007. Thereafter, Amena Begum and others, the decree holder in the S.C.C. Suit No. 3 of 2004 filed an application for vacating the said Order dated 26.07.2000.
